items.title: The restriction of the relative dualizing complex to a fibre is a dualizing complex

items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S with omega^bullet_{X/Y} = f^!O_Y in D^b_Coh(X), a point y in Y and the projection h : X_y -> X, the lemma asserts that Lh^*omega^bullet_{X/Y} is a dualizing complex on the fibre X_y (statement lines 5129-5137). The proof first uses Lemma labelled lemma-perfect-comparison-shriek to place omega^bullet_{X/Y} in D^b_Coh, records that being a dualizing complex is a local property, then applies Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-locally to reduce to showing that (X_y -> y)^!O_y is a dualizing complex on X_y, which is Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-dualizing (proof lines 5139-5147). Passing from the global statement to the fibre through the local base change comparison is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
